Name: Stardew Cheesecake
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]Currently compatible with 1.6 Update[/size]



[line]
[size=5]Features[/size]

This mod adds 9 flavors of cheesecake to Stardew Valley:

[spoiler]
Plain
Strawberry
Blackberry
Blueberry
Cherry
Mango
Orange
Matcha
Chocolate
[/spoiler][s]
[/s]

Likes/Dislikes are based on characters' existing preferences for sweets, cheese, and the fruits in the recipe. If anyone would like a detailed list, I can make one and put in this description under a spoiler.

I may add more recipes in future updates. The recipes can be purchased from Marnie at any time.

Two versions are available, one with new, more realistic cheesecake textures and one with the old textures.


[size=5]Update Log[/size]


Version 1.1- 2 new requested flavors have been added, Orange and Mango!

Version 1.2- More flavors! Chocolate and Matcha are now available.

Version 1.3- Compatible with 1.6. Added new cheesecake textures. No longer requires JSON Assets.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
